summary: Add one inline comment to an existing source file in the YAS application to improve readability; this is a minimal documentation change with no functional impact, fitting quick_fix as it modifies 1-3 files in one repo with no API, schema, or behavioral changes.

steps.why: Convert the ticket into one implementable story with acceptance criteria for adding a single comment.
steps.instructions: Focus on selecting an appropriate location in existing code where a comment would genuinely improve readability, ensuring the comment explains the purpose or rationale of nearby code.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Only one document (inline story) will be produced; no cross-artifact consistency check is needed.

checks.why: The ticket adds only a comment with no changes to any API, schema, queue, database, config, endpoint, parameter, field, job, table, event, message format, or env setting.
Adding one comment requires no file-by-file plan; a developer can identify an appropriate location and add the comment directly from the ticket requirements.
This is a single atomic change (one comment) that cannot be split into separate stories.
